answer_1.quote: To enable LMs to predict multi-RVQ codes with a deep RVQ layer in text-to-audio generation, we propose Siren, a novel framework that employs collaborative transformers with anti-causal alignment.

answer_2.quote: Following previous works , we employ Fréchet Distance (FD), Fréchet Audio Distance (FAD), Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence, Inception Score (IS), and CLAP score.

answer_4.quote: To better validation, we conducted a comprehensive user study involving 20 human experts, who evaluated audio samples generated by three distinct systems: AudioX (representing the state-of-the-art in diffusion models), DelayPattern (the leading language model-based approach), and our proposed method, Siren.
answer_4.guideline: raters were presented with a set of three audio clips—one from each system—and were asked to rank them according to two key dimensions: Fidelity Quality, which assesses overall audio realism and sound clarity, and Instruction Following, which measures how accurately the audio reflects the given prompt.
